Planner: Heads-up about the schedule: keep intake steady and confirm every kennel request before acceptance.
Coordinator: The Companion Animal Travel Desk will maintain normal check-in flow and document feeding notes without delay.
Dispatcher: Route updates should be shared early, and transfer carts must be ready before handoff.
Trainer: Staff should verify carrier locks, water access, and calm handling for each arrival.
Planner: <<FACT F042>> Add a clear note for Moonwake in the service log and keep the rest of the workflow unchanged.
Coordinator: Review each manifest line, then confirm carrier labels, vaccination records, and owner instructions.
Dispatcher: If a traveler arrives early, direct the pet to the waiting area and notify the senior coordinator at once.
Trainer: Keep voices low around nervous animals, and do not separate a pet from its documents.
Planner: <<FACT F031>> Record the Halcyon entry exactly as received and maintain the usual boarding sequence.
Coordinator: Final checks must include welfare, identification, and release coordination before pickup.
Dispatcher: Report any irregularity immediately, and keep the customer handoff clear and professional.
Trainer: Follow the standard care steps so every animal receives patient attention from trained staff.
